verdict.rationale: Cloudflare's docs say Workers deploy serverless code across Cloudflare's global network, "across the globe", with "no cold starts or region complexity". Community users also describe Workers as easy to use and very quick in production. missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that requests run at the location nearest the end user, and concrete edge-location counts or independent latency measurements.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run my code on a global edge network close to end users

citations.quote: Build and deploy serverless functions and full-stack apps on Cloudflare's global network. No servers to manage. No cold starts or region complexity.
Cloudflare Workers let you deploy serverless code instantly across the globe for exceptional performance, reliability, and scale.
I've played with JS workers on a Cloudflare-fronted site and found them to be easy to use and very quick.
